evidence.title: FORMULA 1 ANNOUNCES 24-ROUND CALENDAR FOR 2027
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Beginning in Bahrain on 12-14 March, the 2027 season will comprise 24 Grands Prix in 22 countries. [e002:f02] Pre-season testing will also take place at the Bahrain International Circuit, which is set to host the opening race for the first time since 2024, on 24–27 February. [e002:f03] The new calendar features 10 Sprint races, up from six in 2026, including the season finale in Abu Dhabi, upping the stakes if the title remains undecided when we head to the Yas Marina Circuit. [e002:f04] Half of the 10 Sprint venues will host F1’s shortened format for the first time, with Bahrain, Australia, Japan, Monaco, and Abu Dhabi joining five returning Sprint locations. [e002:f05] Canada and Great Britain will hold Sprint events for the second successive season, while Italy, São Paulo and Qatar complete the list. [e002:f06] Two fan favourites will make a popular return to the calendar. [e002:f07] The Portuguese Grand Prix at the Algarve International Circuit in Portimão and the Turkish Grand Prix at Istanbul Park are back on the schedule for the first time since 2021. [e002:f08] The Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix will not take place in 2027 as part of an agreement to rotate annually with the Belgian Grand Prix. [e002:f09] For the second successive season, the Monaco Grand Prix will move from its former May slot to 4-6 June, therefore avoiding a clash with the Indianapolis 500 and the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the other two events in motorsport’s Triple Crown. evidence.title: 楽天、F1チーム「スクーデリア・フェラーリHP」とのグローバルパートナーシップを発表
evidence.body: [e006:f01] これにより楽天は、2027年1月1日（金）より、国内初の通信およびEコマース領域における「チームパートナー」となります。 [e006:f02] 本パートナーシップは、イノベーション、テクノロジー、そして卓越性の追求という共通の価値観を持つ、世界的なブランドである両者を結び付けるものです。 [e006:f03] 「スクーデリア・フェラーリHP」が誇る世界的な影響力およびスポーツ界における輝かしい歴史と楽天のグローバルなテクノロジーネットワークおよび「楽天エコシステム（経済圏）」を融合させることで、イノベーションの新たな機会を創出するとともに、楽天のパートナー企業とのビジネスエンゲージメントの強化を加速します。 [e006:f04] 本パートナーシップはサーキットの枠を超えて、Eコマース領域や、楽天グループで通信プラットフォーム事業を展開する楽天シンフォニーを含む「楽天エコシステム」の新たな機会を追求するものです。 [e006:f05] 国際的なプラットフォームであるF1を活用してグローバル展開を拡大し、ビジネスにおける新たな関係性の構築や技術力の訴求、そして業界の垣根を超えたイノベーションの創出を追求します。 [e006:f06] また本パートナーシップの一環として、「スクーデリア・フェラーリHP」のレーシングカー、ドライバーのウェア、チームの活動拠点など様々な場所で楽天のブランドロゴが掲出される予定です。 [e006:f07] イタリア・Ferrari S.p.A.でチーフ・レーシング・レベニュー・オフィサーを務めるロレンツォ・ジョルゲッティ氏は次のように述べています。 [e006:f08] 「楽天を『スクーデリア・フェラーリHP』のパートナーに迎え入れることは、世界中に強力な基盤を持ち、イノベーションの力に対して共通の信念を持つ両ブランドが結び付く絶好の機会です。 [e006:f09] 楽天はデジタル領域において独自のエコシステムを構築しており、その技術力はサーキットの枠を超えて我々が価値を創造するための新たな道を開いてくれます。 [e006:f10] 2027年より共に取り組み、このパートナーシップが双方の組織および私たちのグローバル・コミュニティーに創造できる機会を追求していけることを楽しみにしています」 楽天グループ株式会社の代表取締役会長兼社長である三木谷 浩史は次のように述べています。 [e006:f11] 「最高峰のモータースポーツは、技術革新における卓越性の飽くなき追求やファンとの特別な絆の構築によって成り立っており、これこそ私たちが『スクーデリア・フェラーリHP』と共有している決意です。 [e006:f12] このパートナーシップは、楽天が持つテクノロジーの力、デジタルエコシステム、そして独自の会員体験を世界中の何百万人もの熱狂的なフェラーリおよびF1のファンに直接届けるために、ダイナミックな世界規模の舞台をもたらしてくれるものです」 楽天は今後も、スポーツを通じて人々をエンパワーメントするため、革新的なパートナーシップを通じて、スポーツ界全体の活性化および発展に寄与する様々な取り組みを行ってまいります。 [e006:f13] 以 上 ※ここに掲載されている情報は、発表日現在の情報です。 [e006:f14] 最新の情報と異なる場合がございますので、あらかじめご了承ください。 [e006:f15] シェア: Viber シェア Viber ダウンロード プレスリリース お知らせ 年 月 カテゴリ 年 月 カテゴリ。

evidence.title: Ferrari launches investigation after Lewis Hamilton Spanish GP DNF
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Ferrari has already uncovered some early indications of the cause of Hamilton’s DNF, with the seven-time world champion having suffered from a long brake pedal that forced him to retire from the Madring race. [e001:f02] Ferrari early findings from Lewis Hamilton SF-26 investigation Hamilton went side-by-side with Red Bull’s Max Verstappen into Turn 1, as Verstappen took to the run-off. [e001:f03] Red Bull later asked the Dutchman to give the position back to Hamilton, after the FIA stewards noted he left the track and gained an advantage. [e001:f04] That became a complicated task as not only had Verstappen passed Kimi Antonelli, but Hamilton’s brakes were beginning to fail. [e001:f05] Verstappen did let Hamilton through, but quickly re-passed him as Hamilton’s issues worsened. [e001:f06] After the race, Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur had been asked whether Hamilton’s issues stemmed from that moment with Verstappen into Turn 1. [e001:f07] Vasseur confirmed that Hamilton was suffering with a long brake pedal. [e001:f08] Hamilton had been collecting track limit violations as he fought to keep his SF-26 on the road. [e001:f09] Following on from Vasseur’s statement that work was underway on Hamilton’s Ferrari, new information has emerged from the team’s investigation. [e001:f10] Investigation ongoing at Ferrari as to what failed on Lewis Hamilton’s car in Madrid, but early indications are that it was not the primary braking system, but ancillaries within, distinct from the mechanisms themselves. #F1 — Thomas Maher (@thomasmaheronf1) September 15, 2026 ’s Thomas Maher writes: “Investigation ongoing at Ferrari as to what failed on Lewis Hamilton’s car in Madrid, but early indications are that it was not the primary braking system, but ancillaries within, distinct from the mechanisms themselves.” Hamilton suffered a crash in the third and final practice session at the Madring. [e001:f11] After multiple requests from race engineer Carlo Santi to stop the car, Hamilton was told that it was a formal request from the FIA race director, and finally stopped. [e001:f12] Hamilton’s FP3 crash, and his brake issue on Sunday, do not appear to be connected. [e001:f13] Hamilton did clonk the wall with his rear left in the opening stages of the Spanish Grand Prix. [e001:f14] Hamilton now trails F1 2026 Drivers’ Championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 101 points, following his DNF in Madrid. evidence.title: Kimi Antonelli's latest F1 win quietly raised eyebrows for one big reason
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The win was his F1-leading eighth of the season, seventh from the front row, and allowed him to extend his lead in the world championship standings to 81 points, more than three full Grand Prix victories, over teammate George Russell with nine races remaining on the 23-race 2026 calendar. [e002:f02] Russell entered the 2026 season as the clear favorite to win the world championship , with Mercedes expected to dominate from the get-go to begin Formula 1's new era of regulations. [e002:f03] That is indeed how things looked early on, with Russell leading a 1-2 Mercedes finish in the season-opening Australian Grand Prix in Melbourne on a weekend that saw Antonelli crash in practice. [e002:f04] Kimi Antonelli sent a message F1 fans can't ignore But in the 13 races that have been contested since, Russell has been victorious only once, while Antonelli appears to be on his way to becoming the first driver to win the Formula 1 world championship after entering the season with zero career wins since Keke Rosberg in 1982 . [e002:f05] And with his eighth win, Antonelli has already passed Russell on the all-time wins list . [e002:f06] It's a development that not many would have seen coming, after Antonelli struggled mightily in his rookie season as many fans and critics questioned whether or not it was the right move to bring an 18-year-old straight into Formula 1 with a top team such as Mercedes. [e002:f07] There was even speculation that he would be replaced by Max Verstappen after just one year. [e002:f08] Even in the days leading up to the 2026 season, for as obvious as Mercedes' advantage was, Antonelli wasn't even listed as one of the top four favorites . [e002:f09] Russell is in his fifth season at Mercedes and has seven wins, while Antonelli has twice as many wins as his teammate since becoming his teammate only a year and a half ago, even after an extremely rough 2025 campaign. [e002:f10] Of Mercedes' nine most recent wins, eight belong to Antonelli. [e002:f11] While the speculation of Verstappen replacing Russell in 2027 was recently shut down by his Red Bull contract extension, don't be surprised if the 28-year-old Briton's future is called into question once again next year if Antonelli's dominance continues. [e002:f12] But for now, Russell simply needs to worry about holding onto second in the standings. [e002:f13] He's currently 20 points ahead of Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, whom Antonelli replaced, but he had been behind Hamilton until recently. [e002:f14] Formula 1 has off this coming weekend, but the following weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix is set to kick off the first of three straight tripleheaders. [e002:f15] That race is a Saturday race, not a Sunday race, and is set to be shown live on Apple TV beginning at 6:55 a.m. [e002:f16] ET on Saturday, September 26.

evidence.body: [e003:f01] これまで開発を牽引してきた角田哲史トラックサイド・ゼネラルマネージャー兼チーフエンジニアが退任し、現アシスタントLPL（F1プロジェクト副責任者・ソフトウェア部門責任者）の深尾洋一郎氏が新LPLに就任する。 [e003:f02] アロンソも怒ったサインツの危険走行 シーズン中の人事は異例といえるが、同社は「F1パワーユニット（PU）開発のさらなる加速と次世代へのスムーズな移行を目指す」とし、「今回の体制変更は、次世代への確実な技術継承を見据えた計画的な移行」と説明している。 [e003:f03] さらに「2026年に導入された新レギュレーションに続き、2027年以降もさらなる規則変更への対応が求められる中、早期に新体制へ移行することで、競争力の高いPUを目指し、強固な開発体制を構築していく」としている。 [e003:f04] ワークスプロジェクトとしてF1に本格的に復帰した今季はアストンマーティンとパートナーシップを組んでスタート。 [e003:f05] レギュレーション変更に伴い、新たなPUも投入したが、開幕前から異常振動などのトラブルに見舞われ、上位争いに食い込むことができず、コンストラクターズランキングは11チーム中10位。 [e003:f06] 大幅にアップデートしたスペック2のPUをオランダGPから投入したが、ドライバビリティーの改善に取り組んでいる真っ最中で、ここまで入賞はわずか2回でフェルナンド・アロンソがモナコで10位、オランダで9位とレッドブルとコンビを組んでいた昨季までとは大違いで大苦戦している。 [e003:f07] 2015年にマクラーレンと組んでF1に復帰した際もPUの信頼性不足、パフォーマンス不良に悩まされたが、プロジェクトリーダーが交代したのは翌年3月1日だった。 [e003:f08] ワークス活動を1年でいったん終了した後もレッドブル陣営に規模を縮小して「ホンダレーシング」による限定的な活動としてPUの供給を継続。 [e003:f09] それでも新レギュレーションへの対応に遅れ、これまで肩を並べてきたメルセデス、フェラーリ陣営の後塵を拝する形となった。 [e003:f10] 1960年代の第1期プロジェクトを含めて2、3、4期と必ず優勝を飾ってきた。 [e003:f11] 現プロジェクトは第5期に数えられており、低迷したまま活動を終らわせるわけにはいかない。 [e003:f12] 外部サイト 「これ以上アップデートはない。 [e003:f13] 今年はもう、この車でやっていくしかない」母国GPで失意のアロンソ 現地メディアも落胆「目指しているレベルから大きくかけ離れていた」 ハジャーに浮上した“重症説” スペインGPで「終わった」と落胆の角田裕毅に継続参戦の可能性「レッドブルが公表してない別の怪我を負っている」 日々快適に、そして各々が目指す結果に向けてサポートするマガジンとして、多くの方々の「ココロ」と「カラダ」のコンディショニングを整えるのに参考になる媒体(誌面＆WEB)を目指していきます。

evidence.title: SpaceX to conduct Flight 14 Starship orbital launch on September 22, no landing catch is planned
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Elon Musk’s space company will attempt the Flight 14 Starship launch (IFT-14) on Tuesday, September 22, 2026. [e001:f02] Flight 14 lower stage Super Heavy Booster 21 and upper stage Ship 41 have already completed major pre-flight tests. [e001:f03] Booster 21 performed a massive [33-engine static fire at the end of August](https:// while Ship 41 had already [completed its 6-engine static fire](https:// a few days ago. > The 14th flight of Starship is preparing to launch as soon as Tuesday, September 22, pending regulatory approval. [e001:f04] The 75-minute launch window will open at 7:15 a.m. [e001:f05] Over the past two weeks, SpaceX has been working to secure approvals from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to conduct Starship’s 14th flight. [e001:f06] Before the September 22 confirmation date, [an FCC filing hinted](https:// that Flight 14 was planned for September 15. [e001:f07] Contrary to Elon Musk’s claims that SpaceX will attempt to catch the Starship upper stage in Flight 14, it has been completely removed from the [planned mission objectives](http:// – Advertisement – [! [e001:f08] [Image 1: Flight 14 Starship 41 mounted on a test stand at the Massey's Outpost, Starbase, Boca Chica, Texas.](https:// Flight 14 Starship 41 mounted on a test stand at the Massey’s Outpost, Starbase, Boca Chica, Texas. [e001:f09] Most probably, SpaceX still hasn’t been granted approval for a landing catch of the upper stage at Starbase, Texas. ## Flight 14 Planned Trajectory Since the landing catch of the upper stage has been canceled in Flight 14, the Starship spacecraft will now target a soft splashdown landing in the Pacific Ocean to the west of Chile. [e001:f10] In Flight 14, the orbital Starship will reach a maximum altitude of 275 km (170 miles) above sea level. [e001:f11] Starship’s 14th launch will be the first mission in which the upper stage will reach orbit. [e001:f12] SpaceX wrote in its [official update](https:// > The upcoming flight is planned to be the first to send Starship into orbit around Earth. [e001:f13] By going to orbit, the next phase of developing Starship to be fully and rapidly reusable can begin. > > > Starship’s initial orbital mission is expected to fly at an altitude approximately 275 km above Earth and complete approximately six orbits around the planet over the course of a nearly 10-hour flight, with splashdown targeted in the Pacific Ocean to the west of Chile. > > > > – Advertisement – > > > For the first 13 Starship flight tests, we’ve intentionally placed the upper stage on a passively safe suborbital trajectory. [e001:f14] [Image 2: Diagram of Flight 14 Starship launch and landing trajectory.](https:// Diagram of Flight 14 Starship launch and landing trajectory (click/tap to open high-resolution version). [e001:f15] Credit: SpaceX. ## Starship Flight 14 Objectives In short, SpaceX has two major objectives for the Flight 14 Starship mission: * The orbital launch of the Starship upper stage * Deployment of 26 Starlink V3 real working satellites SpaceX explained these further as: > The booster’s primary test objective on Flight 14 will be executing a successful launch, ascent, stage separation, boostback burn, and landing burn at an offshore landing point in the Gulf of America. [e001:f16] That’s ~10x the capacity compared to a single launch of V2 mini Starlink satellites on Falcon 9. > > > After deploying from Starship, the Starlink V3 satellites will unfold their antennas and deploy their solar arrays and make initial contact with the ground and the rest of the Starlink constellation via radio frequency and laser links.

evidence.title: Starship Flight 14: One Launch to Boost Starlink Capacity 3%
evidence.body: [e002:f01] SpaceX is targeting Tuesday, September 22, 2026, for Starship's 14th test flight — a mission that will deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites and, according to figures shared on X by Sawyer Merritt, boost the entire Starlink constellation's capacity by roughly 3% in one go. [e002:f02] It's the first operational Starlink V3 deployment, the first Starship mission to place its upper stage into a stable orbit, and arguably the clearest demonstration yet of why SpaceX has been racing to get Starship into service. [e002:f03] Source: @SawyerMerritt — Sep 16, 2026 The Numbers Behind the 3% Claim Each Starlink V3 satellite is designed to add approximately 1 terabit per second (Tbps) of capacity to the network. [e002:f04] Twenty-six of them on a single Starship translates to roughly 26 Tbps of new downlink capacity added in one mission. [e002:f05] According to SpaceX's own published figures, that is about 10 times the capacity delivered by a Falcon 9 flight carrying V2 Mini satellites — which is why Merritt notes it would take 10 Falcon 9 launches and 277 V2 satellites to match the throughput gain from a single Starship deployment. [e002:f06] The 3% headline figure has not been formally confirmed by SpaceX in public documentation, but it lines up with the math against a constellation of roughly 11,000 operational satellites, most of them earlier-generation V1.5 and V2 Mini units with far lower per-satellite throughput. [e002:f07] Key Figures Metric Value Target launch date September 22, 2026 (pending regulatory approval) Launch window opens 7:15 a.m. [e002:f08] CT / 12:15 GMT Launch site Starbase, Texas Payload 26 Starlink V3 satellites Per-satellite capacity ~1 Tbps Total mission capacity ~26 Tbps Constellation capacity boost ~3% in a single launch Falcon 9 equivalent 10 launches / 277 V2 Mini satellites Orbit altitude ~275 km Mission duration ~10 hours, six orbits, Pacific splashdown Why Starship Was Non-Negotiable for V3 Starlink V3 satellites are physically too large to fit inside a Falcon 9 fairing. [e002:f09] Flight 14 is the first data point on that curve, and the 3% jump from a single launch is a preview of how quickly the numbers can move once Starship enters a regular deployment cadence. [e002:f10] The Mission Profile Flight 14 is also the first Starship mission designed to place its upper stage into a stable orbit — every prior test flight has been suborbital. [e002:f11] This is the third generation of the Starship and Super Heavy hardware, and the mission is designed to validate on-orbit satellite deployment mechanics — a capability SpaceX will need to prove reliably before Starship can take over the bulk of Starlink launches. [e002:f12] If it succeeds, the economics of the Starlink network shift materially: instead of measuring capacity growth in Falcon 9 batches of 20-something V2 Mini satellites, SpaceX will be measuring it in Starship batches of 25+ V3 satellites, each roughly 10x more capable per unit. [e002:f13] Cadence signals — how quickly SpaceX schedules Flight 15 and subsequent V3 deployment missions will indicate whether Starship is ready to enter operational rotation or needs additional test flights first. [e002:f14] If Flight 14 works, the constellation stops being a Falcon 9 story and starts being a Starship story, and the growth curve steepens accordingly. [e002:f15] See every test flight, official outcome and the next launch window in our SpaceX Starship Tracker . evidence.title: 3 Lessons Learned From SpaceX for Anthropic IPO Investors This October
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Well, according to The Motley Fool's research, 7 out of 10 of you are planning on it . [e004:f02] That's even after what happened to the IPO investors of Space Exploration Technologies ( SPCX +5.15% ) , aka SpaceX. [e004:f03] Here are three lessons we learned from the SpaceX IPO that should be very useful to Anthropic IPO investors in the fall. [e004:f04] Lesson 1: IPO day doesn't mean IPO price Days before SpaceX went public, investors already knew its IPO price: $135 per share. [e004:f05] So, when IPO day rolled around on Friday, June 12, IPO investors paid the expected $135 per share. [e004:f06] As of this writing, SpaceX's stock is at $151.37 per share, meaning that investors who bought actual IPO shares (at $135) are in the black, but most other day-one investors are in the red. [e004:f07] Anthropic investors should expect a similar price difference between IPO shares and other shares bought on IPO Day. [e004:f08] Lesson 2: Pick the right broker Historically, the vast majority of IPO shares have been reserved for institutional investors. [e004:f09] Individual investors were seldom offered a piece of the (true) IPO pie: They had to wait to buy shares on the open market once trading began. [e004:f10] SpaceX's IPO broke with this tradition, reserving about 30% of its IPO shares for retail investors through several different brokerages , including Robinhood Markets ( HOOD -5.46% ) and SoFi Technologies ( SOFI -1.35% ) . [e004:f11] Robinhood and SoFi Active Investing, for example, allow all their account holders to access IPO shares, regardless of account balances. [e004:f12] Still, it made a special exception for the SpaceX IPO, lowering its threshold to just $2,000. [e004:f13] If you're hoping to access Anthropic IPO shares, make sure your brokerage will receive an allocation you can access. [e004:f14] That's roughly the midpoint between the IPO price of $135 and the Nasdaq debut price of $150. [e004:f15] There's likely to be more volatility ahead for the newly public SpaceX as it tries to successfully launch its Starship program and build out its AI infrastructure. [e004:f16] As another very high-profile IPO, Anthropic is also likely to have a volatile opening day/week/month/year.

evidence.title: Honduras, Peru, Bolivia and Argentina join Starlink agreements
evidence.body: [e007:f01] In some cases, these contracts include models that allow the company to invest in equipment in exchange for deducting those amounts from its mandatory contribution to the universal service fund. [e007:f02] In recent weeks, Honduras, Peru, Bolivia, and Argentina have confirmed or advanced agreements with SpaceX’s satellite service to connect schools and rural areas, adding to previous agreements with Paraguay, Mexico, and Ecuador, as well as with subnational states. [e007:f03] In an event led by Honduran president Nasry Asfura, on September 10 the Digital Transformation in Education program was launched, which will make it possible to connect 8.000 schools. [e007:f04] The plan envisages the installation of 10.000 Starlink antennas. [e007:f05] The announcement comes after the executive agreement was published in July enabling the use of universal service funds (1% paid by telecommunications operators) to finance the acquisition of satellite broadband equipment. [e007:f06] The same week, the ministry of Human Capital, the Argentine regulator Enacom and Starlink signed the contract for the project Satellite Connectivity in Publicly Managed Educational Establishments of the Argentine Republic, which calls for installing 6,000 kits to bring internet to rural schools and schools in isolated areas throughout the country. [e007:f07] An investment of almost US$22 million (mn) is estimated, with Starlink contributing US$9.9mn for kits and service during the first 24 months and the regulator providing US$11.8mn for installation and management. [e007:f08] The resolution published in September allows this expenditure to be deducted, in the future, from the mandatory monthly 1% contribution that Starlink must make to the universal service fund. [e007:f09] Salta installed 237 antennas in 2025 (with another 132 in progress in health centers), Córdoba already had around 1,300 connected schools in August, Mendoza distributed 500 antennas among rural producers and also signed with the reseller Orbith to connect 213 school institutions, and Catamarca and Chubut moved forward with the operator Telecentro (300 and 120 antennas, respectively), which also resells Starlink. [e007:f10] In Bolivia, meanwhile, on August 19 the Ministry of Education’s Connected Classroom program was launched, with the purpose of adding 1,000 Starlink antennas in the department of La Paz as the first batch toward a nationwide goal of 4,500 antennas. [e007:f11] The Ministry of Education of Peru plans to connect 55,000 public schools with satellite connectivity through an investment of 242mn soles (US$72mn) over five years, although it did not reveal partners for the project, it reported in early September. [e007:f12] Previously, Paraguay had announced an agreement between state-owned Copaco , the Ministry of Technologies and Starlink to install 1,600 satellite internet kits in schools. [e007:f13] Mexico was one of the first to choose Starlink to connect schools, but, unlike the direct agreements in the rest of the region, Starlink won in 2023 a tender from state-owned CFE for the “Internet for All” program, with a contract worth 1.805 billion (bn) pesos in effect until December 31, 2026. [e007:f14] However, a review by the Federal Audit Office (ASF) released in November 2025 found that 39.4% of the installed sites (2,990 out of 7,595) were out of service or not activated by the end of 2024, with 1,776 of the 10,000 purchased units stored with no plan for use. [e007:f15] However, so far Starlink remains the only company that commercially offers low-orbit satellite broadband in Latin America and the one preferred by governments for their connectivity plans. evidence.title: SpaceX、年間133億ドル規模のコンピュート契約を締結
evidence.body: [e009:f01] CFOのBret Johnsonは、「ゴールドマン・サックス・コミュナコピア＋テクノロジー・カンファレンス 2026」において、コンピュート契約による年間収入は現在411億ドルに達していると明らかにしました。 [e009:f02] これは、年間133億ドル、月額11億1,000万ドルに相当する追加契約を締結したことによるものだとInvesting.comが報じています。 [e009:f03] この新契約は2026年12月から収益を生み始める予定で、SpaceXにとって今年4件目の大型AI容量提供契約となります。 [e009:f04] Johnson氏は、この契約は AI 顧客向けのホスティング契約であると説明しましたが、顧客名は明らかにされませんでした。 [e009:f05] 同社はこれまでに、Anthropic（月額12億5,000万ドル）、Google Cloud（月額9億2,000万ドル）、Reflection AI （月額1億5,000万ドル）などと契約を締結しています。 [e009:f06] また今年7月には、数十億ドル規模となる可能性のあるペンタゴン向けコンピュート契約について、米国国防総省と協議を行っていると報じられていました。 [e009:f07] SpaceXは2026年6月30日時点で約1.4GWのデータセンター容量を稼働させていたと推定されていますが、今年末までに2GW超、2027年末までには 10GW規模 に近づくことを目指しています。 [e009:f08] 傘下のxAIは当初、自社の大規模言語モデル（LLM）であるGrokの開発に注力しており、テネシー州メンフィスにあるColossusデータセンターのコンピュート容量を社内利用していました。 [e009:f09] しかし、その方針は変化したようです。 [e009:f10] Anthropicとの契約後、CEOのイーロン・マスクは、データセンターのコンピュート需要を持つ顧客の獲得を積極的に進めていることを明らかにしました。 [e009:f11] 同社のポートフォリオには、Colossus 1およびColossus 2のデータセンターが含まれています。 [e009:f12] ミシシッピ州サウスヘイブンでは第3データセンターを建設中であり、一方テネシー州メンフィス周辺では第4データセンターの 開発 も始まっています。 [e009:f13] 同社は今年6月に株式公開（IPO）を実施しました。 [e009:f14] 上場後には企業価値が急上昇し、一時は3兆ドル近くまで達しましたが、その後は下落しています。 [e009:f15] それでも現在の時価総額は2兆ドルとなっています。 [e009:f16] 本記事は海外Data Centre Dynamics発の 記事 をData Center Cafeが日本向けに抄訳したものです。
